title: Vertical CINEMA blade sign on the tower
where: north face, tower tier 1, x=7 flank pylon (z=4..5), y=17..26
instruction: Use signboard(g,'CINEMA',{at:[23,19,5],face:'north',mode:'hanging',wood:'birch'}) or stack wall signs one letter per row (C,I,N,E,M,A) on the pylon side face x=24, facing east, black text, glow:true.

title: Film-title sign boards under the marquee
where: under the marquee soffit, z=3, x=12 and x=18, y=2..4
instruction: Put a signboard on the marquee's east and west end faces (x=9 and x=21 outer cells): signboard(g,'METROPOLIS',{at:[8,6,3],face:'west',mode:'wall',wood:'birch',width:3,height:1}) and the same for 'THE JAZZ SINGER' on face east at x=22. Text max 12 characters per line.

title: Gold finials on the tier-2 and tier-1 pylons
where: tops of pylons at x=7,23 y=32 and x=9,21 y=42, z=4..5
instruction: On each pylon top add a lightning_rod (waxed) or end_rod stack of 2 above the slab cap, via mcd paint rule: north peak -> finial end_rod+lightning_rod corner.

title: Sea-lantern light strips up the tower pylons
instruction: Replace every 4th quartz block in the pylon column z=5 with sea_lantern (g.set(x,y,5,'sea_lantern')), starting 3 above the pylon base, so the tower glows at night.

title: Door-pull and kick details on the entrance doors
where: north vestibule door wall z=8, x=11,12,18,19, y=1..2
instruction: Add mullion glazing: glazing(g,{at:[12,3,8],face:'north',preset:'transom'}) for the fanlights; put B.trapdoor('dark_oak','north','bottom',false) kick plates at y=1 beside each door.

title: Planters flanking the entrance
instruction: Raised bed: 2x1 polished_blackstone_slab border with azalea + pink_tulip on top (planter(g,{at:[8,1,4],face:'north',...}) or by hand); one per side, symmetrical.

title: Add EXIT sign lamps and wall lanterns on the sides
where: east and west walls x=1 / x=29, z=14,22, y=4
instruction: Use mcd paint: 'east row 4 cols (fins) -> attach lantern every 8' on the side fins, one lantern per 2 fins, to light the side street.

title: Gilded trim on the T2/T3 cornice rings
where: front wall z=6 just below the tier cornices: y=25 (x=9..21) and y=35 (x=11..19)
instruction: Place a full gold_block course under each cornice lip at the front: y=25 for x=9..21 (tier 1 cornice) and y=35 for x=11..19, z=6, replacing nothing but air-facing wall cells, so each tier shows a gilt line.

title: Rear stage house: lower fly-tower block on the back roof
instruction: Build a hollow quartz/sandstone box 15x10x5 with setbacks(g,{base:[8,18,24],footprint:[15,10],tiers:[{height:5,block:'smooth_sandstone',coping:{block:'smooth_quartz_slab'}}]}); add a row of 3 vent louvres on its north face.

title: Back wall: EXIT lamps and a loading-door canopy
where: back wall z=33, x=5..7 and x=23..25, y=3..4
instruction: Over each iron exit door add a 3-wide smooth_quartz_slab canopy at y=4 projecting 1 (z=34) with stair brackets (upside-down smooth_quartz_stairs) at both ends.
